summary: The ansible.builtin.unvault lookup reads the contents of files on the controller, decrypting them if they are vault-encrypted. It does not support globbing or shell environment variables in paths.
questions: How do I read a vault-encrypted file's contents into a variable on the control node?
Can a lookup decrypt an Ansible Vault file that lives on the controller?
Does the unvault lookup accept wildcards like *.txt in the path?
Will unvault work on a plain unencrypted file too?
Can I use $HOME in the path given to the unvault lookup?

answer_card.title: Read vaulted files with the unvault lookup
answer_card.answer_md:
Use `lookup('ansible.builtin.unvault', '/path/to/file')` to get the contents of a file on the **controller**. It works whether the file is vault-encrypted or not.

Limitations: no globbing (`*`) and no shell environment variable expansion in the path.
